subject: ENGLISH
title: Retell It in Order · M01 D19
objective: Retell a story in beginning-middle-ending order.
introduction: Tell the story again from the start! Keep the beginning, middle, and end in order, in your own words.

vocabulary.definition: To tell a story again in your own words.
A tale with characters and events, told in order from beginning to end.
The last part of a story, where the events wrap up.

items.prompt: What is the middle of a story?

options.text: The part where the events and problem happen

items.explanation: The middle is where the story’s events and problems happen. The first event is the beginning, and the last event is the ending.
First tells you the retelling is starting. Finally and Next belong later in the order.

items.prompt: Which order retells a story the right way?
items.explanation: A retelling goes beginning first, then middle, then ending. The other orders jump around.

items.prompt: Which word often signals the final event?
items.explanation: Finally tells you the last event is coming. First opens the story, and before points to an earlier time.

items.prompt: Which sentence belongs at the END of a retelling?
items.explanation: Finally marks the last event, so it belongs at the end. First and Next come earlier.
